sonnet.problem: This card tells Nebuchadnezzar besieging Jerusalem, which is military violence and the start of Judah's fall. It ends on a joke ('That is NOT company dropping by.') instead of care or a plain statement that this part is heavy.
sonnet.rule: **Heavy moments.** A card that tells death, violence, abuse, serious sin or the body's private matters has no joke. He can show care instead, marked as his own ("I think this one hurts"). He can say once, simply, that a part is heavy.
